proposal.reasoning: The goblin warrior is blocking the way to the armory and continues to attack, reducing my health. My previous attacks have been ineffective due to low stamina and the goblin's defense. I cannot flee, so I must continue fighting. Attacking is the only available action to try to defeat the goblin and achieve my goal of arming myself.

proposal.goal_evidence: bob_johnson says: Arm yourself with a weapon before you follow the ash, because what waits at the shrine will not be polite.
